Some day the feds came to me to ask about {f_botName}. 
I don’t know what they wanted, but they asked me really weird questions like ‘what places is she familiar with’ or ‘does she have someone trusted’.
Oh, I think my shift is over... {{wi}}It’s time to go to sleep…
Tomorrow is a very hardworking day…{{wi}} like always...
